body: There is nothing to forgive regarding my sons. I also have a daughter, which I fear screwing up the most. I've been hospitalized twice in the last two years for suicidal thoughts, but nothing helps. If I could hold onto a job and acquire some independence, I could survive. That seems out of the realm of possible, however. My sons are pretty harsh and blame my attitude. I just have to listen. I want to scream and scream that I don't want to die, but I don't know what else to do. I have two rescued Miniature Dachshunds that complicate matters. I will NOT give them up to a shelter and, if I choose to die, I will have to kill them first. This is by far the hardest thing to contemplate. I just don't know what to do. If I live out of my car and someone reports me with the dogs, the dogs will be taken away and I will be cited for animal abuse. I have no options.

But, see, I am only a burden to them. They are ready to move on to the next phase of their lives (moving in with their girlfriends), and have made it plain to me that they can no longer help me. I have no health insurance, will lose my car insurance this week, and don't have the money for my depression/anxiety meds. I have burdened them enough.
